name: Golkunda Diamonds & Jewellery Limited
about: Golkunda Diamonds & Jewellery Limited manufactures and sells diamond studded jewellery in India and internationally. The company's products include rings, pendants, bracelets, earrings, necklaces, and bangles. It also offers cut and polished diamonds, and precious and semi-precious stones. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Mumbai, India. Golkunda Diamonds & Jewellery Limited is a subsidiary of Neverloose Properties & Investment Private Limited.
